reason: A VS Code integration for DeepSeek Harness centered on agent chat, tool execution, planning, subagents, workspace context, and session workflow management, with documented workspace-write and Git rollback capabilities.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体聊天、工具调用、规划、子代理和工作区会话管理集成到 VS Code 中。
summaries.en: Integrates DeepSeek Harness agent chat, tool calls, planning, subagents, and workspace session management into VS Code.

capabilities: Connects VS Code to a local DeepSeek Harness server
Provides agent chat with streamed replies, tool calls, approvals, plans, goals, and subagents
Can attach workspace files and folders as model context
Can run or display bash, PowerShell, and subagent jobs through the connected harness
Can modify workspace state through configured permissions and restore Git workspace checkpoints
Can read Git diffs to generate commit messages
Can manage model providers, credentials, settings, sessions, and workspaces
